overview_description.description:
Sendo is an eCommerce site that offers a wide range of consumer products that include clothing, homeware, cosmetics, tech accessories, and more. The company helps online shoppers find daily deals, promotions, and handbooks with product listings in the categories of women’s fashion, men’s fashion, mother and baby, homeware, food, cosmetics, tech accessories, and sports and entertainment. Sendo’s product delivery network spreads across 64 cities where users can choose to make payments through credit cards, ATM cards or by a bank transfer.

Sendo.vn was founded in 2012 and is headquartered in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam.
